high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from FandomWire, written by Mishkaat Khan on September 8, 2025. The headline reads: "Henry Cavill’s Man of Steel Loses Box Office Battle, David Corenswet’s Superman to Make $82.3 Million More Profit." The article discusses the financial success of David Corenswet's portrayal of Superman, which is projected to generate $125 million in profits during its theatrical run.
